description: This is a PHP unit test class for the TimezonesAPI within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin, specifically testing the API endpoints related to time zones functionality.

classes.name: TimezonesAPITest
classes.description: PHP unit test class for testing the TimezonesAPI endpoints including getAll, delete, create and validation rules.

methods.name: testGetAll

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll

methods.description: Tests that the delete functionality is not implemented and throws an expected exception.

methods.description: Tests the getValidationRuleForDelete method, expecting it to throw a not implemented exception.
